monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral charger-and-cable decision system covering exact-device instructions, input, port, cable, power source, battery condition, recall status, disposal, returns, and total cost. No merchant, model, live price, discount, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, product image, paid placement, or generic product link was added; using the maker-supported existing equipment or buying nothing remains a valid outcome.

image_qa.note: The two new articles and site-index upgrade use original text, evidence tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No PTSD illustration, cannabis product, device, battery, charger, cable, merchant, affiliate, stock image, product photo, or generated image was added or changed, so there is no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue.

search_console.decision: The October 5–November 1 report is seven days old and valid: 786 impressions, four clicks, 0.509% CTR, and average position 24.632. Search Console still records the canonical sitemap as pending with one error and the legacy WordPress endpoint with two errors, so the Data-led item strengthens the site-owned discovery path with a complete dated server-rendered index, a fourteen-day recent view, and an optional accessible filter; it does not claim to change Google’s processing state. ‘510 vs disposable’ had only two impressions at position 12 and already maps to an existing comparison page; Blue Dream had 18 impressions near position 45, outside the target 4–20 range; single-impression legal queries were also too weak. Those query signals were deliberately ignored as tiny, duplicative, or out of range.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy PTSD evidence boundary with a six-claim matrix, five-horizon function record, concurrent-care plan, urgent-response lane, and clinician handoff grounded in the 2023 VA/DoD PTSD guideline, VA National Center for PTSD, and NIH/NCCIH. Reciprocal links strengthen the PTSD, mental-health response, tolerance and withdrawal, and clinician-conversation cluster. No speculative outreach target was logged and no outreach was sent.
